description: This file defines the AccountTransferStandingInstruction class, which models standing instructions for account transfers within the Fineract platform. It includes fields for transfer details, recurrence, amount, status, validity dates, and methods for creating, updating, validation, and deletion of instructions.

classes.name: AccountTransferStandingInstruction
classes.description: Entity class representing standing instructions for account transfers, with creation, update, validation, and deletion logic.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Static factory method to instantiate a new AccountTransferStandingInstruction with provided parameters, including recurrence details.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the instruction's fields based on the provided JsonCommand, tracking changes and performing validation.

methods.name: updateLatsRunDate
methods.description: Updates the last run date of the standing instruction.

methods.name: updateStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of the standing instruction.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Soft deletes the instruction by setting status to DELETED and appending '_deleted_' to the name.

methods.name: validateDependencies
methods.description: Validates logical dependencies between fields such as date ranges and recurrence settings.
